mentions.name: Todo List (GNOME extension)
mentions.description: This GNOME Shell extension puts a todo list on the GNOME desktop, letting users keep their daily todos close at hand to stay motivated and focused.
mentions.problem: Daily todos aren't visible and close by, which makes it harder to stay focused and motivated.
mentions.source_excerpt: Working on a gnome todo list extension, I like to keep my daily todos very close, it motivates me to stay focused.

evidence.value: Working on a gnome todo list extension, I like to keep my daily todos very close, it motivates me to stay focused.
